cfg.f.updates.notify_window: Window that announces a new version
cfg.h.updates.notify_window: When the update check finds a newer version, a window shows the summary of its changes with a button to the Updates page. It is on by default; it never appears on wall or kiosk screens, and one version can be dismissed. It needs the update check (updates.check).
ui.supply_notice_no_summary: The notes of this release have no summary; open the changelog to read what changed.
cli.supply_help_keyring: the public keys that may sign (list, add, revoke, verify a document)
cli.supply_help_verify_release: check a folder of release files against SHA256SUMS and its signature, without network
cli.supply_help_key_id: the name of a key (revoke also takes its fingerprint)
cli.supply_help_public_key: the Ed25519 public key to add, 64 hexadecimal digits
cli.supply_help_expires: the last day the key is valid, YYYY-MM-DD
cli.supply_help_document: the file to verify; its signature is the same name with .ed25519.sig
cli.supply_help_folder: the folder with the files of a release
cli.supply_need_add: Give a name (--key-id), a public key (--public-key) and what it signs (--key-scope).
cli.supply_need_id: Give the name or fingerprint of the key (--key-id).
cli.supply_need_folder: Give the folder with the release files (--folder).
cli.supply_release_ok: The release files are complete and signed by the project.
cli.supply_release_bad: These files cannot be trusted as a release of the project.
